# cursor_models (Data Source)

Reads GET /v1/models, the catalog of model.id values accepted by POST /v1/agents, including parameters and variants. Do not use it to validate automation model or Admin model-access ids until Cursor confirms the catalogs are the same.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cursor_models" "catalog" {}
```
